name: Dal Methi
steps: Rinse the dal and simmer with turmeric and 950 ml water for 35–45 minutes until soft enough to mash. Stir occasionally and replenish water if the pan becomes dry.
Pick the fenugreek leaves, discard tough stems and wash thoroughly to remove grit. Chop the leaves, onion, garlic and tomato separately.
Heat ghee and sizzle cumin. Cook onion for 6 minutes, add garlic for 1 minute, then tomato, chilli powder and salt; cook for 6–8 minutes until pulpy.
Add fenugreek and stir for 4 minutes until wilted. Mix in the dal and remaining 150 ml water; simmer for 5 minutes, then switch off and add lemon juice.
notes: Base recipe for 4 adults. Cooking times are estimates; follow the texture and doneness cues. Jain suitability follows your saved ingredient choices.
